Package com.rocket.radar.events

Class Event.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.rocket.radar.events.Event.Builder
Enclosing class:
Event
public static class Event.Builder extends Object
Builder class for constructing Event objects using the Builder pattern. Provides a fluent interface for setting event properties.
